plan.notes: Official Catalog Year 2026-27 pathway map ('Course Sequence by Term', Full-time sequence) from Phoenix College. Terms are the college's own suggested sequence; full-time status is 12-18 credits per semester. Credit ranges (e.g. 3-6, 1-3, 0-3) are summed at their minimum in total_credits. Data-quality notes: the official map lists DHE110/DHE112 in both Term 6 and Term 7 ('as offered by the college of attendance') - sequenced once in Term 6. DHE201/DHE202 appear in Term 6 ('Required for MCC and RSC') and Term 8 ('Required for PC') - sequenced once in Term 6; this is a multi-college consortium program (MCC/RSC/PC). Deduplicated rows: DHE110 in Term 7; DHE201 in Term 8; DHE202 in Term 8. Variable-credit convention: the official Catalog Year 2026-27 Phoenix College pathway map lists CRE101 (0-3), HCC/RES109, DHE201, DHE202 with credit ranges whose minimum is 0; transcribed at the catalog minimum and marked required_zero per the documented variable-credit convention (excluded from sums, kept in sequence). ENG107 and RDG100 are prerequisite courses named by the official map (ENG102/BIO156 prereqs) but not part of the sequenced program; listed in external_prereqs, never invented as degree courses. Coordinator fix 2026-10-06: verified against the official source; validated under build.py gates extended per coordinator decision 2026-10-05 (BACKLOG-18 wave 32), documented in build.py comments.
